text: The Prophet ﷺ kissed al-Hasan ibn Ali, and told a man who had never kissed his children: «Whoever is not merciful will not be shown mercy» (Sahih al-Bukhari 5997). Show your child love today with a kiss or a hug they welcome, without tying your love to obedience.

review_defects.why: A statement about the Prophet ﷺ is presented without any source citation; per policy a missing source is safer than an invented one, so this is noted as low only.
